theme: Finding the right route at a station
sourceNote: Original TalkTag dialogue. Calibration only: private Markdown references My Close Call, PDF pages 5–7 (A-level concrete trip planning); Stranger Things s01e01, PDF pages 1–3 (B-level conversational turn-taking and immediate problem-solving); The King's Speech, PDF page 1 (C-level checking information before speaking or acting). No source sentence or translation is reproduced.
drill: Guided Listen & Repeat: listen to one spoken turn and reproduce it after a 2.5× response gap

A1.title: Finding Platform Two
A1.situation: A traveler asks for the platform and checks the train.
A1.learnerInput: Four short station turns, one at a time.
A1.expectedOutput: Repeat each turn clearly and ask for the correct platform.

lines.speaker: Roger
lines.en: Excuse me. Where is platform two?
lines.ko: 실례합니다. 2번 승강장은 어디예요?

lines.speaker: Lauren
lines.en: Go straight and turn left.
lines.ko: 쭉 가서 왼쪽으로 도세요.

lines.speaker: Roger
lines.en: Is this the right train?
lines.ko: 이 열차가 맞나요?

lines.speaker: Lauren
lines.en: Yes. It leaves in five minutes.
lines.ko: 네. 5분 뒤에 출발해요.

A2.title: Getting to City Hall
A2.situation: A traveler asks how to reach City Hall by train.
A2.learnerInput: A short route conversation with one transfer.
A2.expectedOutput: Repeat the route and confirm where to change trains.

lines.speaker: Roger
lines.en: I need to get to City Hall.
lines.ko: 시청에 가야 해요.

lines.speaker: Lauren
lines.en: Take the blue line from platform three.
lines.ko: 3번 승강장에서 파란색 노선을 타세요.

lines.speaker: Roger
lines.en: Do I need to change trains?
lines.ko: 중간에 갈아타야 하나요?

lines.speaker: Lauren
lines.en: Yes. Change at Central Station.
lines.ko: 네. 센트럴역에서 갈아타세요.

B1.title: A Delay on the Board
B1.situation: Two travelers respond to a delayed train before an appointment.
B1.descriptionKo: 열차가 지연되어 다른 이동 방법을 찾아요.
B1.learnerInput: A practical delay, possible bus alternative, and a decision.
B1.expectedOutput: Explain the delay, propose a route, and confirm the next action.

lines.speaker: Roger
lines.en: The board says our train is delayed by twenty minutes.
lines.ko: 전광판에 우리 열차가 20분 지연된다고 나와 있어.

lines.speaker: Lauren
lines.en: If we take the bus now, we might get there sooner.
lines.ko: 지금 버스를 타면 더 빨리 도착할 수도 있어.

lines.speaker: Roger
lines.en: Let's check when the next bus leaves.
lines.ko: 다음 버스가 언제 출발하는지 확인해 보자.

lines.speaker: Lauren
lines.en: Good idea. I don't want to miss the appointment.
lines.ko: 좋아. 약속에 늦고 싶지 않아.

B2.title: Finding a Step-Free Route
B2.situation: A traveler needs an accessible route after a station lift stops working.
B2.descriptionKo: 엘리베이터가 고장 나 계단 없는 경로를 물어요.
B2.learnerInput: An access problem and a workable alternative.
B2.expectedOutput: Describe the obstacle and ask for a step-free route.

lines.speaker: Roger
lines.en: The lift to platform four is out of service.
lines.ko: 4번 승강장으로 가는 엘리베이터가 고장 났어요.

lines.speaker: Lauren
lines.en: Is there another step-free way to reach the train?
lines.ko: 계단을 이용하지 않고 열차로 갈 수 있는 다른 길이 있나요?

lines.speaker: Roger
lines.en: Yes. Use the south entrance and follow the signs.
lines.ko: 네. 남쪽 출입구로 가서 표지판을 따라가세요.

lines.speaker: Lauren
lines.en: That takes longer, but it avoids the stairs.
lines.ko: 조금 더 걸리지만 계단은 피할 수 있겠네요.

C1.title: Conflicting Platform Information
C1.situation: Two travelers resolve conflicting app and station information.
C1.descriptionKo: 앱과 안내 방송이 달라 직원에게 확인해요.
C1.learnerInput: An apparent discrepancy, verification, confirmation, and coordination.
C1.expectedOutput: Qualify uncertain information, verify it, and relay the update.

lines.speaker: Roger
lines.en: The app says platform six, but the station announcement says eight.
lines.ko: 앱에는 6번 승강장이라고 나오는데, 역 안내 방송에서는 8번이라고 하네.

lines.speaker: Lauren
lines.en: Let's check with a staff member before we cross the station.
lines.ko: 역 반대편으로 가기 전에 직원에게 확인해 보자.

lines.speaker: Roger
lines.en: They confirmed the train moved to eight at the last minute.
lines.ko: 열차가 막판에 8번 승강장으로 바뀌었다고 확인해 줬어.

lines.speaker: Lauren
lines.en: I'll tell the others now so nobody waits in the wrong place.
lines.ko: 다른 사람들이 엉뚱한 곳에서 기다리지 않게 지금 알려 줄게.

C2.title: Choosing the Reliable Connection
C2.situation: Two travelers weigh a risky late connection against a reliable earlier departure.
C2.descriptionKo: 빠른 환승과 확실한 도착 사이에서 선택해요.
C2.learnerInput: A time-saving option with a hidden risk, followed by a reasoned choice.
C2.expectedOutput: Articulate a conditional risk and defend a practical trade-off.

lines.speaker: Roger
lines.en: The timetable shows a connection, but we'd have only four minutes to change platforms.
lines.ko: 시간표상으로는 환승이 되지만, 승강장을 옮길 시간이 4분밖에 없어.

lines.speaker: Lauren
lines.en: If the first train runs late, we could be stuck here after midnight.
lines.ko: 첫 열차가 늦으면 자정이 넘어서 여기 발이 묶일 수도 있어.

lines.speaker: Roger
lines.en: Let's leave a little earlier, even if that means waiting longer between trains.
lines.ko: 열차 사이에 좀 더 기다리더라도 조금 일찍 출발하자.

lines.speaker: Lauren
lines.en: Agreed. Getting there reliably matters more than saving ten minutes.
lines.ko: 동감이야. 10분 아끼는 것보다 확실히 도착하는 게 더 중요해.
